name: Register
description: Registration marks: a ring with the crosshairs running out past it, one per plate.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 22%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 62%, #000 62%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 62%, #000 62%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(46.5% 0.0%, 53.5% 0.0%, 53.5% 46.5%, 100.0% 46.5%, 100.0% 53.5%, 53.5% 53.5%, 53.5% 100.0%, 46.5% 100.0%, 46.5% 53.5%, 0.0% 53.5%, 0.0% 46.5%, 46.5% 46.5%); clip-path: polygon(46.5% 0.0%, 53.5% 0.0%, 53.5% 46.5%, 100.0% 46.5%, 100.0% 53.5%, 53.5% 53.5%, 53.5% 100.0%, 46.5% 100.0%, 46.5% 53.5%, 0.0% 53.5%, 0.0% 46.5%, 46.5% 46.5%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
